scripts.render: npm run soundtrack && npm run render:frames && npm run encode && npm run mux && npm run poster
scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -start_number 0 -i out/frames/frame-%03d.png -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/semantic-hedge-fund-promo-silent.mp4
scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i out/semantic-hedge-fund-promo-silent.mp4 -i public/soundtrack.wav -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/semantic-hedge-fund-promo.mp4
